courses.summary: 溫山公開資料包含煉油、基礎油與石化產品；課程以多產品園區的收率、熱量與品質接口展開。本課依序分析燃料與化工產品分配、守恆成分品質混合、不同產品熱需求、多使用者氫氣帳、品質分槽有效庫存，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Onsan publicly describes refining, base oils and petrochemicals; teaching examines yield, heat and quality interfaces in a multi-product site. The course analyses allocation between fuels and chemicals, blending a conserved quality constituent, heat demand by product stream, hydrogen account for multiple users, usable segregated-grade inventory, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
